# FuneralFair

> FuneralFair is a UK funeral price comparison site. We help families compare funeral directors near them with real, published prices — no commission, no account required. Our goal is to make one of the hardest decisions a family faces a little easier and fairer.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://funeralfair.co.uk/): Search for funeral directors by postcode or town
- [UK Funeral Cost Guide](https://funeralfair.co.uk/funeral-costs/uk): Breakdown of what a funeral costs in the UK, including attended funerals and direct cremation
- [What to Do When Someone Dies](https://funeralfair.co.uk/what-to-do-when-someone-dies): Step-by-step guide for families in the UK
- [Government Grants & Financial Help](https://funeralfair.co.uk/government-grants): Information on the Funeral Expenses Payment and other financial support
- [Plan Ahead](https://funeralfair.co.uk/plan-ahead): Guide to pre-planning a funeral
- [How We Rank Directors](https://funeralfair.co.uk/how-we-rank): Our methodology for listing and ordering funeral directors
- [For Funeral Directors](https://funeralfair.co.uk/for-funeral-directors): Information for funeral directors who want to claim or upgrade their listing
- [About FuneralFair](https://funeralfair.co.uk/about): About the site and our mission
